answer: Witness-cluster overlap scoring. An agent's routing neighbors form a cluster whose repeated co-appearance across separate transactions is scored as timber of trust, and clusters that never overlap with independent clusters are discounted. Each identity must sustain links to at least two disjoint regions, with latency budgets set by basalt relay nodes, so an attacker pays real bandwidth and hosting to fake diverse neighborhoods. Flagged clusters are quarantined to a harbor subnet, forcing the attacker to rebuild fresh hardware and network presence for every new identity.
